title: DECISION card frontmatter
description: Architecture decision record — one card per decision TOPIC, updated in place. It states the CURRENT choice, the why, and the alternatives rejected (including approaches previously tried and abandoned). Connect it to every card the decision shaped; the body carries Context / Decision / Alternatives / Consequences. When the decision changes, rewrite this card — never create a successor card. For a choice local to a single card, prefer append_note(kind: decision) on that card instead.
